what: Photo fragments scattered above the big title ride along a hidden SVG curve. From when the section’s top edge touches the top of the screen until its bottom edge reaches screen center (scrub .1), flow fragments glide from the nearest point on the curve to one slot ahead over .8s power2.inOut (.2 stagger), shrinking 1→0 and fading from the 60% mark. Then pop fragments sit evenly along the back part of the curve (.6~1), pop out 0→1 from 15vw away on the opposite side of the tangent (1s power2.out, .5 stagger), and all get pushed another 20vw along their own tangent. With pin: true, the section is pinned for half a screen without a spacer

options.span: Front part of the curve used by flow pieces (0–1), default .6 — jumping pieces come after it
options.each: Gap between flow pieces (timeline units), default .2
options.dur: Length of one flow segment (timeline units), default .8
options.push: Distance pushed further along the tangent (ratio of screen width), default .2
options.from: Distance on the side opposite the tangent where the flying pieces start (ratio of screen width), default .15
options.end: Where the flow ends, default bottom center
options.pin: if true [data-fx-part=pin] (or the element if absent) is pinned from top top → bottom center without pinSpacing
options.[data-fx-part=path]: Curve to flow — <svg data-fx-part="path" viewBox=… preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d=…/></svg>(required). Size the box with css
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Flow piece — the user places it with left·top·width
options.[data-fx-part=pop]: Bouncing piece — the part places the slot on the curve

use: …

from.where: index.html .ow-hero (inside the site, index.js runs the same calculation directly through the second curve and third group) — original hero phase1Images·phase2Images·phase3Images, createPathSampler·getPhaseOneArcSegment(i, n+1, .6), w timeline scrub .1 top top → endTrigger bottom center, L timeline tangent × .2vw

note: The original bounces a third group once more over the second curve (ring shape) — the part takes only one curve, so if a third group is needed, attach the same part once more in a section below. The entrance (pieces behind the loader going from curve cells into place in .7 power3.out) lives in the site index.js.
